description: ValidationPolicy has all-public fields and derives Default. There is no constructor that requires current_time_unix to be provided. This means every caller must either use ..Default::default() (which gets time=0 silently) or write out all fields. A constructor fn new(current_time_unix: u64) -> Self would make it impossible to accidentally use time=0. Without one, the common pattern ValidationPolicy { max_path_len: N, ..Default::default() } is a footgun. The type should enforce that current_time_unix is always explicitly set.
title: ValidationPolicy has no constructor — only Default or field init
